desc:
🍕 THROW BAIT, CATCH BRAINROTS! 🧠

Do pull-ups to get strong, then throw your bait as far as you can. A brainrot will chase it down, and it's yours to keep!

💪 TRAIN on your pull-up bar and pop 2x bubbles to build Power
🎯 THROW: stop the meter on PERFECT for a longer throw
🦖 CATCH 96 brainrots across 16 zones, from Common all the way to Cosmic
🏠 PLACE them on your base to earn cash every second
🍝 BUY better bait for more luck and upgrade to stronger bars
📖 COMPLETE the Index: finish a zone for a cash bonus
💎 REBIRTH for permanent Power and cash boosts

🍀 Buy Server Luck to boost luck for everyone in the server!
🎁 Gift passes to your friends

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new zones and brainrots!
